def expire_hold(tool: str) -> str | None:
    """The first member did not collect within PICKUP_WINDOW_HOURS: tell them, drop them, return the next member."""
    if _QUEUES[tool]:
        lapsed = _QUEUES[tool].popleft()
        send_email(lapsed, f"Your hold on {tool} has lapsed",
                   f"You did not collect {tool} within {PICKUP_WINDOW_HOURS} hours, so it has gone to the next "
                   "member in the queue. You can place a new hold at any time.")
    return _QUEUES[tool][0] if _QUEUES[tool] else None

nodes.body: How long is the pickup window? The desk is staffed three days a week. The board decided on 2026-09-10 that it is 48 hours from the ready notice.
nodes.title: Pickup window length

nodes.body: When a held tool becomes available, the member has a pickup window. If it is not collected in time, the hold lapses and the tool passes to the next member in the queue. The window length is undecided.
nodes.title: Expire uncollected holds

nodes.body: A member can place a hold on a catalogued tool that is on loan.

acceptance_criteria: A member without overdue items can place a hold on any catalogued tool.
Holds on the same tool are served first come, first served.

nodes.title: Place a hold

nodes.body: When a held tool is ready for pickup, the member is notified by email.

acceptance_criteria: The email names the tool and the pickup deadline.
